title: Seeking Secrets, Part 1
description: Seeking Secrets, Part 1 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Die in the Halfassin's Halfway House off Level 3 in the Shadow's Embrace, journey through the underlife, and steal the secret plans from the R&D lab. Afterward, meet with Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Seeking Secrets, Part 2

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Die in the Halfassin's Halfway House off Level 3 in the Shadow's Embrace, journey through the underlife, and steal the secret plans from the R&D lab. Afterward, meet with Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Hypothetically speaking, I may have additional intelligence suggesting an as-yet-unnamed organization is attempting to subvert the Kingdom's resurrection system. K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S., a royal order that allegedly exists to support and defend this system, cannot allow that to happen. However, before any action can be taken, the identity of that as-yet-unnamed organization needs to be named.

Some might suggest that your kingdom needs your help once again, Dungeon Runner. Since the only way into these R&D labs is through the underlife, you might consider going into the Halfassin's Halfway House off Level 3 in the Shadow's Embrace and die there. Once you've made your way into that level's R&D lab, find any secret plans you can find and return them to me here in the Shadow's Gate.

Now go and find some way to die. Shouldn't be too hard for someone of your skill level.

Turn-in:

You have secret documents? Well, I'm sure there aren't for me, but I'll hold onto them until the rightful owner wanders by.... *wink!*

Objectives:

  • Secret Project: Chester Cheddarhead ×1

Level range: 45–100
